# Results (pilot-g1.1; generated by paper/build_results.py from results/pilot-g1.1-ANALYSIS.json)

180 trials; total model cost $4.02 (Claude Haiku 5.5 $0.08, Claude Opus 5.5 $3.06, GPT-6.1 Sol $0.88).

## A correct layer helps; a wrong one is followed

| Model | C0 correct | C1 correct | E correct | F1 correct | F1 followed | F2 correct | F2 followed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Opus 5.5 | 83% | 92% | – | 58% | 42% | 100% | 0% |
| GPT-6.1 Sol | 83% | 100% | – | 17% | 75% | 50% | 50% |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 | 83% | 100% | – | 50% | 50% | 83% | 17% |

- **H1 (coherent faults are followed more than contradictory ones):** fault-following F1 − F2 = +33 points [95% CI +17, +53].
- **H2 (a missing element beats a wrong one):** correct E − F1 = not estimable.
- Value of the correct layer (exploratory X4): correct C1 − C0 = +14 points [95% CI -6, +39]; layer minus the anchored element (X5): correct E − C0 = not estimable.

## Detection and the cost of skepticism

| Model | D1 on F1 | D2 on F1 | D1 on F2 | D2 on F2 | Layer concerns C1 | C1+A | C1+N |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Opus 5.5 | 83% | 83% | 100% | 100% | 33% | – | – |
| GPT-6.1 Sol | 50% | 50% | 100% | 100% | 0% | – | – |
| Claude Haiku 5.5 | 67% | 58% | 100% | 100% | 0% | – | – |

- **H3a (audit raises located detection on F2):** +0 points [95% CI +0, +0].
- **H3b (audit raises layer concerns on the correct layer):** not estimable.
- Exploratory: audit reduces *following* of contradictory faults (X1, F2 − F2+A) +19 points [95% CI +8, +31]; of coherent faults (X2, F1 − F1+A) not estimable; silent failure on coherent faults (X3, F1 − F1+A) not estimable.
